title: Musician’s Ribbon Snag
content: The torn ribbon points suspicion toward Lio Fen, but the snagged tear suggests it was caught while someone hurried past rather than used in the office struggle.

title: Lio’s Set Ended Early
content: Lio’s final tune ended well before the bell rang, contradicting his first claim that he was continuously onstage during the alarm.

title: Office Boot Print
content: The wet footprint was made by official harbor-issue tide boots from the office, meaning the print could have been staged by someone with routine access.

title: Ledger Chain Was Unlocked
content: The pearl ledger was not ripped free. Its clasp was opened with a fitting duplicate key and then relocked, narrowing opportunity to trusted office holders.

title: Bell Rope Untouched
content: The bell did not ring by hand. The main rope shows no sign of recent pulling, weakening every alibi based only on not being seen inside the bellhouse at the moment of the strokes.

title: Delayed Striker Mechanism
content: The restored striker was rigged with a wax-held maintenance pin so it would release later and ring twelve times automatically in the locked bellhouse.

title: Wrong Tar for Tess
content: The pitch connected to the bellhouse came from public restoration supplies, not Tess Rill’s boatyard stock. Her tar-stained cuffs are suspicious but not proof of the bell plot.

title: Causeway Window
content: The tide exposed a brief route to the lighthouse immediately after the alarm, giving the culprit a way to hide the ledger and possibly the tidewarden while the town gathered at the pier.

title: Assistant’s Blue Lantern Glass
content: The blue shard on the causeway matches assistant tidewarden signal glass, placing Edda’s official equipment on the hidden route when she claimed to be away from the shore.

title: Ledger in Edda’s Satchel
content: The missing ledger was hidden inside an oilskin satchel marked with Edda Vale’s initials, behind lighthouse shelving reachable during the low-tide window.

title: Altered Entries in Edda’s Hand
content: The ledger’s falsified pearl-duty entries match Edda’s handwriting and office ink, revealing why the ledger had to vanish before the tidewarden’s audit.

title: Oren Saw the Blue Lantern
content: Oren saw a blue signal lantern crossing the causeway after the bell rang. He mistook it for a warning at first, but the color identifies assistant tidewarden equipment.
